resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO), Residential Sale
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Englewood Cliffs Building Department (Construction Official)
resale_co.lead_time: Apply at least two weeks before closing. Requests received fewer than 4 business days before closing pay a $150.00 expedite fee.
resale_co.valid_for: If the home is not occupied within six months of issuance, the certificate expires and a new one is needed.
requirements: Inspection of the visible parts of the house for the Property Maintenance Code and Borough building, plumbing, electrical, health, safety and fire ordinances; violations must be corrected (14 days allowed after a notice)

Smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors tested and working at the inspection; signed smoke/CO affidavit (owner, tenant or NJ licensed electrician); smoke detectors over 10 years old and CO detectors over 5 years old replaced
Homes with 110V (hardwired) smoke or CO detection need a written report from a NJ licensed electrician or certified alarm company; existing low voltage alarm/smoke systems must work
Minimum size 10 type ABC fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)
House number at least 3 inches (6 inches if the house is more than 50 feet from the curb), contrasting and visible from the street
Notarized owner affidavit that no sump pumps, storm drains or other devices are connected to the sewer line; notarized room count per floor
All building permits closed and all taxes, penalties and fees due to the Borough paid before closing
Unit doors opening to a corridor must be self-closing and self-latching where applicable
No one may occupy the home before approval from the Fire Inspector

fees.label: CCO, resale (Borough Code 9-17.2)
fees.quote: The fee for a certificate of continued occupancy resale shall be $100, payable to the Borough of Englewood Cliffs.

fees.label: Expedite, request fewer than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: Requests for a CCO received fewer than four business days prior to the closing or change of occupant shall add an additional $150 to required fee.

fees.label: Second or later reinspection (Code)
fees.quote: The fee for a second and any additional reinspection shall be $50 per inspection.

fees.label: Re-inspection after a failed inspection (application form)
fees.quote: Inspections that fail are subject to an additional re-inspection fee of $125.00.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Application for Certificate of Continued Occupancy Residential Sale from the Building page, complete all pages (room count and sump pump affidavits are notarized; smoke/CO affidavit signed by owner, tenant or licensed electrician) and submit it with a $100.00 check payable to the Borough of Englewood Cliffs at the Building Department, 482 Hudson Terrace. Permit pick-up and payment is Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Give the name and phone of the person who will meet the inspector.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official (tech assistant: Cathy Scancarella, cscancarella@englewoodcliffsnj.org)

evidence.quote: A Continuing Certificate of Occupancy is required on all re-sales of homes, and rental properties as well.

Each time there is a transfer of ownership of property within the Borough of Englewood Cliffs, a purchaser of such property must obtain from the construction official of the Borough a certificate of continued occupancy
If a dwelling unit is not occupied within six months of the issuance of a certificate of continued occupancy, the certificate will expire, and a new certificate must be obtained before occupancy.
When you sell your home, your application for Continued Certificate of Occupancy should be made at least two weeks prior to your closings.
Submit a check payable to the Borough of Englewood Cliffs for $100.00.

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Section 9-17 was rewritten by Ordinance 25-07 on November 12, 2025 and was read through ecode360. The Code makes the purchaser responsible for obtaining the CCO; the Borough's application is filed by the seller side. The Code's reinspection fee ($50 for a second or later reinspection) differs from the application form (revised 6/28/24), which says failed inspections carry a $125.00 re-inspection fee; the form predates the 2025 ordinance. The application PDF is a scan and its letterhead phone 201-568-9262 differs from the Borough main number 201-569-5252. Borough Code Section 11-5.2 also requires a sump pump/drain inspection at every CCO or ownership transfer. Rental CCOs ($85) and lead-safe inspections apply to rentals only.

requirements: Smoke detectors by year built: pre-1977 battery units on each level and within 10 feet of sleeping areas; later homes 110V units (interconnected from 8/6/84; battery back-up and in each bedroom after 9/5/91)
Smoke detectors with a manufacture date over 10 years must be replaced; batteries changed at the time of inspection
Carbon monoxide detectors within 10 feet of all sleeping areas; CO detectors over 5 years old replaced
Hardwired (110V) systems need a written report from a NJ licensed electrician or certified alarm company; battery systems need a signed affidavit
Minimum size 10 type ABC fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)

authorities.name: Englewood Cliffs Building Department (smoke/CO checked as part of the CCO); Fire Prevention under the Englewood Cliffs Fire Department is the LEA
authorities.lead_time: With the CCO: apply at least two weeks before closing.
authorities.how_to_apply: The smoke/CO affidavit and electrician or alarm company report are part of the CCO Residential Sale application filed with the Building Department; no separate smoke certificate application or fee is posted.

evidence.quote: Smoke Detectors and Carbon Monoxide Detectors shall be tested and in working order at the time of inspection.

No certificate of continued occupancy may be issued to a residential building or any portion thereof unless approved smoke detector and carbon monoxide detectors have been installed as required by applicable State statute and local ordinance.
LEAID: 0216-001 Englewood Cliffs Boro SMOKE DETECTOR COMPLIANCE Name: Englewood Cliffs Bldg Dept Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Joseph Cardullo Phone (201) 768-4890

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA directory names the Englewood Cliffs Building Department as the smoke detector compliance office and lists Fire Official Joseph Cardullo (fireofficial@englewoodcliffsnj.org; office phone (201) 569-5252, smoke compliance line (201) 768-4890). No separate smoke/CO certificate fee is published; it appears to be covered by the $100 CCO. The Borough form still lists a fire extinguisher (and includes a 2005 DCA extinguisher memo); the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19), so confirm with the Borough.

other_items.label: Sump pump / storm drain affidavit and inspection
other_items.detail: At every CCO or ownership transfer the fire subcode official inspects for sump pumps or drains discharging into the sanitary sewer; the owner signs a notarized affidavit that none are connected. No CCO is issued until any such connection is removed.

other_items.label: House number
other_items.detail: No CCO is issued unless the house number meets Property Maintenance Code Section 10-7.2e (at least 3 inches, or 6 inches if more than 50 feet from the curb, contrasting and visible).

other_items.label: Open permits, taxes and fees
other_items.detail: No CCO is issued before closing without closing all building permits and paying all taxes, penalties and fees due to the Borough.

open_questions: Is the reinspection fee $50 (Code, November 2025) or $125.00 (application form, June 2024)?
Is there any separate smoke/CO certificate fee, or does the $100 CCO cover it?
Does the Borough still require the fire extinguisher after P.L.2025, c.19?
